title.en: Stored thermal energy from pressure profiles

summary: Integrate electron, ion and total scalar pressure profiles independently with the 3/2 factor

capability: Stored thermal energy from pressure profiles
Integrate electron, ion and total scalar pressure profiles with the 3/2 factor over a normalized radial cell grid.
operation: Integrate stored thermal energy from pressure profiles
(p_el, p_ion, p_tot, vpr, drho_norm) -> (W_el, W_ion, W_tot)
discovery.model: Nonrelativistic isotropic-gas internal energy density u = 3p/2; signed finite inputs are accepted as algebraic compatibility.
discovery.geometry: Normalized radial cell grid with explicit volume metric and quadrature weights; rho_norm is a dimensionless normalized radius.
discovery.boundary: Discrete cell-volume sum with no extrapolation or hidden endpoint reconstruction; volume and radial-weight inputs carry the grid convention.

identity.relation: W = 3/2 integral(p dV) for each supplied pressure profile
identity.definition: Return (1.5*sum(p_el*vpr*drho_norm),1.5*sum(p_ion*vpr*drho_norm),1.5*sum(p_tot*vpr*drho_norm)). Inputs are first converted to binary64, then exact rational products and accumulation retain signed cancellation and round only the final result to float64.
identity.model: Nonrelativistic isotropic-gas internal energy density u=3p/2; signed finite inputs accepted as algebraic compatibility
identity.geometry: Normalized radial cell grid with explicit volume metric and quadrature weights
identity.boundary: Discrete cell-volume sum; no extrapolation or hidden endpoint reconstruction
assumptions: Pressure and grid vectors are finite, nonempty, one-dimensional and equal-length.

Physical stored thermal energy requires nonnegative scalar thermal pressures; signed finite arrays remain accepted for algebraic compatibility. Total pressure is supplied independently and not forced to equal electron plus ion pressure.

inputs.name: p_el
inputs.constraints: Finite signed real values; same shape as vpr and drho_norm.

inputs.name: p_ion
inputs.constraints: Finite signed real values; same shape as vpr and drho_norm.

inputs.name: p_tot
inputs.constraints: Finite signed real values; same shape as vpr and drho_norm.

outputs.name: W_el
outputs.constraints: Finite signed scalar on successful return.

outputs.name: W_ion
outputs.constraints: Finite signed scalar on successful return.

outputs.name: W_tot
outputs.constraints: Finite signed scalar on successful return.

preconditions: Pressure and grid vectors are finite, nonempty, one-dimensional and equal-length.

Physical stored thermal energy requires nonnegative scalar thermal pressures; signed finite arrays remain accepted for algebraic compatibility. Total pressure is supplied independently and not forced to equal electron plus ion pressure.
supported: Finite real pressure and grid inputs with positive weights; component energies and total energy for the declared scalar/array shapes.
Rejection of malformed, nonfinite, mismatched or nonpositive-weight inputs with ValueError.
excluded: No equation-of-state conversion from temperature or density.
No physical closure or plasma calibration claim.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for malformed, nonfinite, mismatched pressure/grid inputs or nonpositive weights.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises FloatingPointError for unrepresentable finite float64 results.

example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.physics import calculate_stored_thermal_energy
v=np.array([2.,3.]); d=np.array([.4,.6])
r=calculate_stored_thermal_energy([2,2],[3,3],[5,5],v,d)
assert np.allclose(r,(7.8,11.7,19.5))

scope: Independent Decimal/longdouble conservation and overflow/underflow checks, component independence and malformed inputs.
Signed cancellation across permutations and intermediate product overflow/underflow regression; exact binary64 products and a single final rounding.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Independent numerical probes establish the named mathematical relation, discrete conservation, boundary and shape/failure behavior. They do not establish general plasma calibration or complete edge-model validity.
known_limitations: No equation-of-state conversion from temperature or density.
No physical closure or plasma calibration claim.
Signed inputs are an algebraic compatibility extension; they do not describe positive stored physical energy.
Exact intermediate arithmetic preserves the discrete relation for the converted binary64 inputs; it does not recover precision lost in input conversion or validate the quadrature grid.
